GET /zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdo.description: Returns the desired DNS records for a sending subdomain along with a live diff against actual DNS state. Use this to detect missing, unlocked, foreign, or multi-record conflicts before deciding whether to call the fix endpoint. For wildcard sending rows, each call also rechecks the governing organizational-domain DMARC policy and reports policy drift that DNS Fix cannot repair.

200.description: Get sending subdomain DNS status response

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

errors.description: DNS issues detected against the current zone state.

items.description: A DNS record, sending-configuration, or policy issue detected during preview, status, or fix.

code.description:
Error code identifying the type of issue. `dkim.conflict` is
reported whenever 2+ TXT records exist at the DKIM selector,
even if one matches the canonical Cloudflare content — multi-record
DKIM can permerror at recipient verification regardless of which
entry is correct. `domainkey.delegated` indicates that
`_domainkey.<subdomain>` has NS records in the Cloudflare zone,
creating a zone cut that shadows the DKIM TXT record we publish;
the customer must remove the NS delegation for DKIM to verify.
`dmarc.incompatible` indicates that a wildcard sending row no longer
satisfies its DMARC safety requirements, such as relaxed alignment,
a valid governing policy, and the organizational-domain constraint.
The customer must correct the zone or policy configuration manually;
DNS Fix cannot resolve this error.
`sending_subdomain.conflict` is reported by preview when an enabled
explicit or wildcard sending row would give some senders a different
signing identity.

POST /zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subd.description: Creates a new sending subdomain or re-enables sending on an existing subdomain that had it disabled. If zone-level Email Sending has not been enabled yet, the zone flag is automatically set when the entitlement is present. A leftmost wildcard such as `*.example.com` is accepted only for accounts with wildcard Email Sending enabled. Wildcard senders share the base domain's DKIM signing identity and `cf-bounce.<base>` return path.

name.description: The domain name within the zone. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label (`*.example.com`) and requires the account wildcard Email Sending entitlement.
